qe: The commercial rearing of silkworms for silk production is called:
qh: रेशम उत्पादन के लिए रेशम कीटों के व्यावसायिक पालन को कहते हैं:
e: Concept: Sericulture = resham ki keedia (silkworm) paalna aur unse resham (silk) nikalna; isme mulberry ke patte ugana, keedia palna aur cocoon se dhaaga nikalna (reeling) sab shamil hai. Baaki teen doosre 'culture' hain: Apiculture (madhummakhi palna - honey), Pisciculture (machhliyan paalna), Horticulture (fal, sabzi aur phool ugana). Cocoon se dhaaga nikalne ko 'reeling' kehte hain; ek cocoon se lagbhag 300-900 metre tak resham ka dhaaga milta hai. Mulberry (shahut) resham sabse aam hai jabki 'muga' resham (Assam) apni sunehri chamak ke liye mashhoor hai. Exam point: 'Silk = Sericulture; Honeybee = Apiculture; Fish = Pisciculture'.

qe: Apiculture is the practice of rearing:
qh: एपीकल्चर में किसका पालन किया जाता है?
e: Concept: Apiculture (bee-keeping) = madhummakhi (honeybee) ke chhatte paalan karna taaki shahad (honey) aur mom (beeswax) mile; iske liye khaas 'bee box' (ghar) banaye jate hain, paas me phoolon wale paudhe hote hain (nectar ke liye), aur queen bee ko hifazat se rakha jata hai. Shahad ke alawa royal jelly aur propolis jaise padarth bhi milte hain, aur bees fasalon ka pollination karti hain. Baaki teen alag hain (silkworm = sericulture, fish = pisciculture, poultry). Exam point: 'Madhummakhi paalan = Apiculture (honey + wax + pollination)'.

qe: Farming of fish (fish culture) is known as:
qh: मछली पालन को कहते हैं:
e: Concept: Pisciculture = machhliyan paalna (fish farming) - talaab/farm me machhliyan daal kar khana-intzaam karke unhe bada karna aur phir pakadna; isme 'composite fish culture' (kai kismein ek hi talaab me alag-alag gehrai me - jaise Rohu, Catla, Mrigal saath) bahut common hai kyunki isse paani aur khana dono ka fayda uthaya jata hai. Baaki teen alag hain: Apiculture (honeybee), Sericulture (silkworm), Viniculture (angoor/grape cultivation). Exam point: 'Machhli paalan = Pisciculture'.

qe: Cultivation of fruits, vegetables and ornamental flowers is collectively called:
qh: फल, सब्जी और सजावटी फूलों की खेती को सम्मिलित रूप से कहते हैं:
e: Concept: Horticulture = 'bagwani' - fal (pomology), sabzi (olericulture) aur phool (floriculture) ugane ka vijnyan; isme grafting, cutting, layering jaisi techniques se saal-bhar paidavar badhate hain aur bangal se zyada (trai-state/backyard) se aamad maila badhta hai. Baaki teen: Agriculture (kheti - anaaj, daal, telhan), Floriculture (sirf phool), Sericulture (silkworm). Exam point: 'Fal-sabzi-phool = Horticulture (bagwani); anaaj = Agriculture'.

qe: Rearing of domesticated birds such as hens and ducks for eggs, meat and feathers is:
qh: मुर्गियों और बतखों जैसे पालतू पक्षियों का अंडे, मांस व पंखों के लिए पालन कहलाता है:
e: Concept: Poultry farming = ghar ke pakshiyon (murgi, battakh, turkey, geese) ka paalan - isme unhe khaas 'feed' (khana), teeka (vaccine), aur saaf 'coop' diya jata hai; ande ke liye alag breed (layer) aur mans ke liye alag (broiler) paali jaati hai. Ye dehati parivar ke liye sabse common ghar ka dhandha hai. Baaki teen: Pisciculture (machhli), Apiculture (madhummakhi), Animal husbandry (bada sthanpaayi paalan - gaay/bhains). Exam point: 'Murgi/battakh paalan = Poultry farming (egg + meat)'.

qe: The branch of agriculture that deals with the breeding and care of farm animals (cattle, buffaloes, etc.) is:
qh: पालतू पशुओं (गाय, भैंस आदि) के प्रजनन व देखभाल से जुड़ी कृषि शाखा है:
e: Concept: Animal husbandry = paaltu pashuon ka paalan: unki breed (good breed chunna), khana, bimariyon se bachav, doodh/dahi/andar aur draught (kaam karne wale) ke liye unhe chunna; isme 'milch animals' (doodh dene wali - gaay, bhains) aur 'draught animals' (khinchne/kaam wale - bail, bhains, oont) aate hain. Baaki teen alag cheezein hain (Sericulture, Horticulture, Pisciculture). Exam point: 'Pashu paalan-vigyan = Animal husbandry (doodh + draught animals)'.

qe: Which gas produced during fermentation makes bread dough rise and become fluffy?
qh: किण्वन (fermentation) में बनी कौन-सी गैस रोटी के आटे को फुलाकर हल्का (fluffy) बनाती है?
e: Concept: Bread banane me 'yeast' (Saccharomyces cerevisiae) daala jata hai; ye aate ki shakkar (sugar) ko khakar usko 'fermentation' (khaana-bina-oxygen todna) se alcohol aur carbon dioxide (CO2) gas paida karta hai. CO2 ke bulbule aate ke jaal me fans kar rehte hain, isliye aata phool jata hai aur pakne par wo halka aur spast ban jata hai (aur alcohol garmi me ud jata hai). Baaki teen gases is process me nahi bantee. Exam point: 'Bread phoolna = yeast ki banai CO2 gas (fermentation se)'.

qe: Curd (dahi) is prepared from milk by the action of which microorganism?
qh: दूध से दही किस सूक्ष्मजीव की क्रिया से बनता है?
e: Concept: Dahi banane ke liye doodh me chhota-sa 'starter' (purana dahi) daala jata hai jisme Lactobacillus naam ke bacteria hote hain; ye doodh ki shakkar (lactose) ko 'lactic acid' me badal dete hain - isi acid se doodh ka protein (casein) jamkar thakka (curd) ban jata hai aur dahi khatta lagta hai. Ye 'fermentation' ka roz ka udaharan hai, aur dahi ke bacteria aant ke liye fayde mand (probiotic) hote hain. Baaki teen is kaam me nahi aate. Exam point: 'Dahi/makhan/cheese = Lactobacillus (lactic acid fermentation)'.

qe: Vinegar is produced by the fermentation of alcohol with the help of:
qh: सिरका (vinegar) शराब के किण्वन से किसकी सहायता से बनता है?
e: Concept: Vinegar ka mukhya padarth 'acetic acid' hai. Ye do charanon me banta hai: pehle yeast sugar ko alcohol (ethanol) me badalta hai, phir Acetobacter naam ka bacteria us alcohol ko oxygen ki upasthiti me acetic acid me badal deta hai - isi ko vinegar kehte hain (khane me swaad/achar aur preservative ke liye). Baaki teen: Lactobacillus (dahi), Yeast (sirf alcohol tak), Rhizobium (khet me nitrogen fixer). Exam point: 'Vinegar = Acetobacter (alcohol se acetic acid)'.

qe: In biogas plants, the production of methane-rich gas from cattle dung is carried out by:
qh: बायोगैस प्लांट में गोबर से मीथेन-युक्त गैस बनाने का काम कौन करता है?
e: Concept: Gobar/naali ke khaad jaisa 'biomass' jab hawa ke bina (anaerobic) sadta hai to khaas bacteria - methanogens (archaebacteria jaise 'Methanobacterium') - usme se methane (CH4) gas banate hain; yahi 'biogas' hai jo khana pakane aur bijli ke liye use hota hai. Bacha hua padarth achhi khad ban jata hai (slurry). Baaki teen: Lactobacillus (dahi), Yeast (alcohol/CO2), Amoeba (protozoa). Exam point: 'Biogas (gobar gas) = methanogens (anaerobic) se methane (CH4)'.

qe: Which of the following is a free-living nitrogen-fixing bacterium present in the soil?
qh: इनमें से मिट्टी में स्वतंत्र रूप से रहने वाला नाइट्रोजन स्थिरीकरण करने वाला जीवाणु कौन है?
e: Concept: Mitti me nitrogen fix karne wale bacteria do tarah ke hote hain: (1) Symbiotic - jo paudhe ki jadon ke saath rehte hain jaise Rhizobium (legume dalhon ki jadon me nodules banata hai); (2) Free-living - jo paudhe ke bina akela mitti me reh kar hawa ki nitrogen pakadte hain, jaise Azotobacter aur Clostridium (aur cyanobacteria Anabaena). Azotobacter gram-negative bacteria hai jo kheti ki mitti me natural taur par hota hai aur mitthi me nitrogen badhata hai - isliye biofertilizer me use hota hai. Exam point: 'Free-living nitrogen fixer = Azotobacter (mitti me akela); symbiotic = Rhizobium (nodules me)'.

qe: The Azolla plant, which lives in a symbiotic association with cyanobacteria and is used as a biofertilizer, is commonly grown in:
qh: एजोला पौधा, जो नील-हरित जीवाणु के साथ सहजीवी संबंध बनाकर जैव उर्वरक का काम करता है, आमतौर पर उगाया जाता है:
e: Concept: Azolla ek chhota tairne wala fern hai jiske andar Anabaena naam ka cyanobacteria rehta hai; dono milkar (sahajeevi/symbiotic) hawa ki nitrogen ko pakad kar mitti me pahunchate hain, isliye Azolla ko dhaan (paddy) ke kheton me hari khaad (biofertilizer) ke roop me ugaate hain - isse chawal ki paidavar badhti hai aur raseen khad (urea) kam lagti hai. Baaki teen kaam iska nahi hain. Exam point: 'Azolla + Anabaena = rice field ka biofertilizer (nitrogen fixer)'.

qe: Vermicompost (organic manure rich in nutrients) is prepared with the help of:
qh: वर्मीकम्पोस्ट (पोषक-तत्वों से भरपूर जैविक खाद) किसकी सहायता से तैयार की जाती है?
e: Concept: Vermicompost me khechue (earthworm) koode-kabadi aur pashuon ke gobar ko khate hain aur unka paachan hone ke baad jo 'cast' (maldung) nikalta hai wo bahut upjaau, gehre rang wali khaad hoti hai jisme nitrogen, phosphorus, potash aur khaas 'humus' hota hai - ye rasayanik khaad ka organic vikalp hai aur mitti ki upjau shakti badhata hai. Baaki teen kaam iske nahi hain. Exam point: 'Vermicompost = khechue (earthworm) ki khaad (organic fertilizer)'.

qe: Pasteurization of milk involves:
qh: दूध का पाश्चुरीकरण (pasteurization) क्या होता है?
oe: Heating milk to about 70 degrees C for a short time, then cooling it quickly
oh: Heating milk to about 70 degrees C for a short time, then cooling it quickly
e: Concept: Pasteurization ek process hai jisme doodh ko lagbhag 70 degree C (ya 72 degree C) par chand second ke liye garam kiya jata hai aur phir turant thanda kiya jata hai; isse doodh ke bacteria (jaise TB, typhoid wale) mar jaate hain par doodh ke poshak tatva aur swaad zyada nahi badalte. Iski khoj Louis Pasteur ne ki thi (isi liye naam pasteurization). Baaki teen options doodh ko kharab karte hain ya kaam nahi karte. Exam point: 'Doodh me bacteria marne ka tarika = pasteurization (Louis Pasteur)'.

qe: Adding salt or sugar in large amounts helps to preserve food because it:
qh: नमक या चीनी को अधिक मात्रा में डालने से खाद्य वस्तुएँ खराब होने से बचती हैं, क्योंकि इससे:
oe: Removes water from microorganisms so they cannot grow
Increases the temperature of the food
oh: Removes water from microorganisms so they cannot grow
Increases the temperature of the food
e: Concept: Namak ya cheeni bahut zyada hone par bahar ka ghol 'hypertonic' ho jata hai (matlab usme paani ki matra bacteria ki tulna me bahut kam hoti hai); osmosis (paani ke chhote-chhote kanon ka kam ghanatv se zyada ghanatv ki taraf jana) ke kaaran bacteria ke andar ka paani bahar nikal jata hai, wo sikud jaate hain aur badh nahi paate - isliye achar (namak + tel) aur murabba/jam (cheeni) mahino tak theek rehte hain. Baaki teen kaaran galat hain. Exam point: 'Namak/cheeni se food preservation = water nikalna (osmosis), bacteria sukh jaate hain'.

qe: Refrigeration preserves food mainly because low temperature:
qh: प्रशीतन (fridge) खाना खराब होने से बचाता है क्योंकि ठंडा तापमान:
oe: Slows down the growth and reproduction of microorganisms
oh: Slows down the growth and reproduction of microorganisms
e: Concept: Bacteria/fungi ka badhna temperature par nirbhar karta hai - thand me unki rasayanik kriyayein (metabolism) dheemi ho jaati hain isliye wo bahut dheere badhte hain (khatam nahi hote - isliye fridge ka khana bhi samay ke saath kharab hota hai). Isi wajah se 0-5 degree C me doodh/sabzi kuch din chalti hai aur garam me ghanton me kharab ho jaati hai. Baaki teen kaaran galat hain (thand se turant kill nahi hota, oxygen hatana nahi hota, preservative add nahi hota). Exam point: 'Fridge me khana bachta hai = bacteria ki growth dheemi (mar nahi jaate)'.

qe: Canning preserves food by:
qh: डिब्बाबंदी (canning) खाने को किस तरह सुरक्षित रखती है?
oe: Drying the food in sunlight only
Heating the food in a sealed container to kill microorganisms and sealing it airtight
oh: Drying the food in sunlight only
Heating the food in a sealed container to kill microorganisms and sealing it airtight
e: Concept: Canning me khana tin/glass ke dibbe me bhar kar garam kiya jata hai (jisse bacteria, unke spores aur enzymes mar jate hain) aur dibba hawa-band (airtight) seal kar diya jata hai - hawa ke andar bacteria nahi aa sakte, isliye khana mahino-saal chalta hai. Ek khatra khaas hai: agar sealing kharab ho to Clostridium botulinum bacteria badh kar zeher bana sakta hai (botulism). Baaki teen tarike alag hain (drying, antibiotics, paani me rakhna). Exam point: 'Canning = garam + hawa-band (airtight) sealing'.

qe: The technique of growing plants by supplying nutrients in a water solution, without soil, is called:
qh: मिट्टी के बिना, पोषक तत्वों को पानी के घोल में देकर पौधे उगाने की तकनीक को कहते हैं:
e: Concept: Hydroponics me paudhe mitti ke bajay khaas ghol (nutrient solution jisme nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, calcium, magnesium, iron jaisi minerals gholi hoti hain) me ugaye jate hain - jad coir/perlite/gravel jaise sahara me hoti hai. Isse paani ki bachat hoti hai, khaad ka control rehta hai aur khaas jagah (space station, thandi desh) me fresh sabzi ugaai jaati hai. Baaki teen: Vermicomposting (khechue se khaad), Sericulture (resham), Grafting (paudhe ki katai jodna). Exam point: 'Mitti bina paudhe = Hydroponics (nutrient solution me)'.

qe: Which part of the flower provides the raw material (nectar) that honeybees collect and convert into honey?
qh: फूल के किस भाग से मधुमक्खियाँ मधु (nectar) इकट्ठा करके शहद बनाती हैं?
e: Concept: Phool ke andar khaas granthiyan nectar (meetha ras) banati hain - madhumakhi apne munh ki khaas 'probroscis' (nali) se nectar chusti hai, apne pet ki 'honey stomach' me bharkar chhatte (hive) tak laati hai, wahan wo enzyme (invertase) milakar paani bhaap kar deti hai - ant me gaadha meetha shahad ban jata hai aur chhatte ki mome (wax) wali cells me bharta hai. Baaki teen: Pollen (protein ke liye khana, 'bee bread'), petals (colour se keedon ko bulana), root sap. Exam point: 'Shahad ka kachcha mal = phool ka nectar (pollen se alag)'.

qe: The silk fibre used by humans is obtained from which stage of the silkworm's life cycle?
qh: रेशम कीट के जीवन-चक्र की किस अवस्था से रेशम का धागा मिलता है?
e: Concept: Resham ke keede (silkworm) ka jeevan: anda -> larva (caterpillar, jo mulberry ke patte khata hai) -> larva apne sharir ki laar (salivary gland) ka 'fibroin' protein ek lambi dhaaga bana kar apne chaaron taraf lapet leta hai - isi lapete hue dhanche ko 'cocoon' kehte hain, jiske andar keeda 'pupa' ban jata hai. Insaan cocoon ko garam paani me daal kar (jisse keeda mar jata hai) dhaaga nikaalta hai - isi se resham banta hai. Baaki teen charan se resham nahi milta. Exam point: 'Resham = cocoon (pupa ke charan) se; larva ke 'fibroin' protein se'.

qe: Which of the following is a 'milch animal'?
qh: इनमें से 'दुधारू पशु' (milch animal) कौन है?
e: Concept: Animal husbandry me pashu kaam ke hisaab se baante jate hain: milch animals = jo doodh dete hain (gaay, bhains, bakri); draught animals = jo khet/gaadi me kaam karte hain (bail, bhains, oont, ghoda); aur 'dual purpose' = dono (bhains aam taur par dual hai). Buffalo/Bhains mukhya milch animal hai (bharat me sabse zyada doodh isi ka). Baaki teen draught (kaam-kaj) ke liye hain. Exam point: 'Milch = gaay/bhains (doodh); Draught = bail/oont (kaam)'.

qe: Which of the following is a 'draught animal' used mainly for farm work and transport?
qh: इनमें से किसे मुख्यतः खेती के काम और परिवहन के लिए 'भारवाहक (draught) पशु' कहते हैं?
e: Concept: Draught animals wo pashu hain jinhe vaajan khinchne (hal chalana, gaadi, paani nikalna) ke liye paala jata hai - jaise bail (bullock), bhains (kaam wali), ghoda, khaachhar, oont. Inka mukhya kaam energy (taakat) dena hai, doodh dena nahi. Cow/goat milch (doodh) animals hain aur hen poultry hai. Bhains ek 'dual purpose' pashu hai - kaam bhi karti hai aur doodh bhi deti hai, isliye kisan usko sabse zyada paalta hai. Aaj kal tractor ne bail ki jagah bahut le li hai par jahan tractor nahi pahunchta (khet ki mend, gadde) wahan bail aaj bhi kaam aata hai. Exam point: 'Draught = bail/bhains (kaam); Milch = gaay/bhains (doodh)'.

qe: Natural wool, used for making warm clothes, is chemically a:
qh: गर्म कपड़े बनाने में प्रयुक्त ऊन (wool) रासायनिक रूप से क्या है?
e: Concept: Bhed (sheep) ya bakri ke baal (fleece) se milne wali wool ek protein fibre hai - iska mukhya protein 'keratin' hai (wahi keratin hamare baalo aur naakhun me hota hai). Protein hone ke kaaran wool garam rakhti hai (reshe ke beech hawa tikka leti hai), paani sokh leti hai aur jalne me pilli-panf wali gandh deti hai. Baaki teen galat hain: cellulose kapas/jute me hota hai, fat/ghee alag cheez hai, mineral salt nahi. Exam point: 'Wool = protein (keratin) fibre; cotton/jute = cellulose'.

qe: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
qh: इनमें से कौन-सा युग्म सही सुमेलित है?
e: Concept: In 'cultures' ke naam yaad rakhna zaroori hai: Sericulture = resham ki keedia (silk moth) ka paalan; Apiculture = madhummakhi (honeybee) ka paalan; Pisciculture = machhliyon ka paalan; Horticulture = fal-sabzi-phool ki kheti; Poultry = murgi-battakh paalan; Vermiculture = khechua paalan (compost ke liye). Baaki teen pairs ulte/galat hain (Api = fish/galat, Pisci = honeybee/galat, Horti = silkworm/galat). Exam point: 'Seri=silk, Api=bee, Pisci=fish, Horti=bagwani (isko ulte yaad na karo)'.

qe: Growing plants from a small piece of plant tissue in a nutrient medium under sterile laboratory conditions is called:
qh: पौधे के छोटे ऊतक टुकड़े से प्रयोगशाला की बंध्य (sterile) पोषक माध्यम में नए पौधे उगाने को कहते हैं:
e: Concept: Tissue culture (micropropagation) me paudhe ka ek bahut chhota hissa - leaf/tip ya stem ka chhota tukda (explants) - khaas sterile (bacteria-free) nutrient medium me rakha jata hai jisme hormone (auxin + cytokinin) daale jaate hain; ye cells endless divide kar ke hazaaron identical paudhe (clone) bana dete hain - isse banana, teak, orchid jaisi fasal aur bimari-mukt paudhe tez bante hain. Baaki teen: Hydroponics (bina mitti paani me), Vermicomposting (khechua khaad), Grafting (paudhe ki katai jodna). Exam point: 'Lab me paudhe ka cloning = Tissue culture (micropropagation)'.

qe: Which of the following is used as a bio-pesticide (pest control without harmful chemicals)?
qh: इनमें से कौन जैव-कीटनाशक (bio-pesticide) के रूप में प्रयुक्त होता है?
e: Concept: Bio-pesticide wo hote hain jo paudhon/jeevon se banate hain aur mitti-paani ko zeher nahi karte: jaise neem (Azadirachta indica) ke beej ke 'azadirachtin' tel se bane keet-nashak, Bacillus thuringiensis ka 'Cry' protein (khaas caterpillar marne wala), aur kuch fungus/virus wale preparation. Ye 'Integrated Pest Management' ka hissa hote hain. Baaki teen rasayanik khaad/namak hain (Urea, DAP khaad; namak khaane wala). Exam point: 'Bio-pesticide ke udaharan = neem oil (azadirachtin), Bt (Bacillus thuringiensis)'.

qe: Which of the following is a biofertilizer?
qh: इनमें से जैव-उर्वरक (biofertilizer) कौन है?
e: Concept: Biofertilizer me zinda microorganisms hote hain jo mitti ki upjaau shakti bina rasayanik khaad ke badhate hain: Rhizobium (legume jadon me nitrogen fix karta hai), Azotobacter (free-living nitrogen fixer), Azospirillum, Azolla-Anabaena (dhaan me), aur mycorrhiza (phosphorus lene me madad). Baaki teen rasayanik (chemical) khaadein hain - Urea (nitrogen), Superphosphate (phosphorus), MOP (potash). Exam point: 'Biofertilizer = Rhizobium/Azotobacter/Azolla (jeevit), Urea/DAP/MOP = chemical'.

qe: Leather (chamdi ka bhukta kapda) is made from the skins of animals by a process called:
qh: पशुओं की खाल से चमड़ा बनाने की प्रक्रिया को कहते हैं:
e: Concept: Tanning khaas chemical process hai jisme jaanvaron ki kachi khaal (raw hide) ko is tarah badla jata hai ki wo saadne par bhi na sude aur na sad jaye - isme tannin (ped ki chhaal se), chromium salt ya vegetable extracts use hote hain; ant me lachakdar aur tikau chamda banta hai (joota, belt, bag). Chamde ka istemal kapde ke alawa joota, belt, bag aur furniture me bhi hota hai. Baaki teen textile ke kaam hain: Weaving (bunai), Spinning (katna), Bleaching (safed karna). Exam point: 'Chamda = tanning (khaal ko tikau banana)'.

qe: Which insect is reared for the production of shellac (lac), a resin used in varnish, wax and gramophone records?
qh: शेलैक (लाख) जो वार्निश, मोम और रिकॉर्ड में प्रयुक्त होता है, किस कीट से प्राप्त होता है?
e: Concept: Lac (laksha) ek khaas keeda 'Laccifer lacca' (lac insect) banata hai - ye peepal/palash jaise pedon ki kori tahniyon par chipak kar apne chaaron taraf resham wale padarth ki parat (lac) banata hai; ise scrape karke saaf karte hain. Isse 'shellac' (varnish, sealing wax, polish) banta hai. Bharatiya lakshman/lakh (Jharkhand-Chhattisgarh) ka purana dhandha hai. Baaki teen: silkworm, honeybee, malaria mosquito - alag kaam ke. Exam point: 'Lac/shellac = Laccifer lacca keeda (lac culture = lacciculture)'.

qe: Which of the following is the correct sequence for obtaining mulberry silk?
qh: शहतूत आधारित रेशम (mulberry silk) प्राप्त करने का सही क्रम कौन-सा है?
oe: Mulberry leaves -> silkworm larvae -> cocoon -> reeling of silk
oh: Mulberry leaves -> silkworm larvae -> cocoon -> reeling of silk
e: Concept: Mulberry silk ka safar: (1) shahut paudhe ke patte ugana, (2) silkworm (Bombyx mori) ke ande se larva nikalna aur use patton par palna, (3) larva ka bada hone par cocoon (ka dhaage wala 'koya') banana, (4) cocoon ko garam paani me daal kar resham ka dhaaga nikalna (reeling) - isse hi resham ka kapda banta hai. Baaki teen kram galat hain (ulta, ya bematlab). Exam point: 'Mulberry leaves -> larva -> cocoon -> reeling = silk'.

qe: Which of the following is a commercial product obtained from honeybees apart from honey?
qh: शहद के अलावा मधुमक्खियों से प्राप्त होने वाला व्यावसायिक उत्पाद कौन-सा है?
e: Concept: Madhummakhi apne pet ki khaas granthiyon se 'beeswax' (mome) banati hai jisse wo chhatte (hive) ki 'cells' banati hai - yahi mom candles, lipstick, polish aur cream banane me kaam aati hai. Shahad ke alawa propolis (chhatte ki raksha ka padarth), royal jelly (queen khaati hai) aur bee venom bhi milte hain. Baaki teen: Lac (Laccifer keeda), Silk (silkworm), Tannin (paudhon ki chhaal se, chamda banane me). Exam point: 'Madhumakhi ke utpad = honey + beeswax (+ royal jelly, propolis)'.

qe: Rearing of earthworms for producing nutrient-rich manure and for improving soil health is called:
qh: पोषक-तत्वों से भरपूर खाद बनाने और मिट्टी की सेहत सुधारने के लिए केंचुए पालने को कहते हैं:
e: Concept: Vermiculture = khechue (earthworm) paalna; jab unhe kooda-kabad, gobar aur paudhon ke avashesh khilakar compost (vermicompost) banaya jata hai to ise vermicomposting kehte hain. Khechue mitti ko porrus (chhida) karte hain, hawa aur paani andar jane dete hain, aur unki 'cast' (maldung) mitti me nitrogen-phosphorus-potash aur humus badhati hai. Baaki teen: Sericulture (resham), Apiculture (madhummakhi), Horticulture (bagwani). Exam point: 'Khechua paalan = Vermiculture; usse bani khaad = vermicompost'.

qe: Which of the following statements about crop rotation with pulses is correct?
qh: दलहनी फसलों के साथ फसल-चक्र (crop rotation) के बारे में कौन-सा कथन सही है?
oe: It removes all nutrients from the soil
It adds nitrogen to the soil through Rhizobium, improving the next crop
oh: It removes all nutrients from the soil
It adds nitrogen to the soil through Rhizobium, improving the next crop
e: Concept: Dalhan (chana, matar, moong) ki jadon me Rhizobium bacteria rehte hain jo hawa ki nitrogen ko pakad kar mitti me pahunchate hain (biological nitrogen fixation). Isliye gehu jaisi fasalein lene ke baad ya pehle agar dalhan lagayi jaye to mitti me nitrogen badh jati hai (natural khaad), kam urea lagta hai, mitti ki banawat sudharti hai aur bimariyan bhi kam hoti hain. Baaki teen kathan galat hain. Exam point: 'Crop rotation me dalhan = Rhizobium se mitti me nitrogen badhna'.
